name: Lying Leg Curl
summary: A machine-based isolation exercise performed face down to strengthen and hypertrophy the hamstrings through knee flexion.

setup: Adjust the machine pad so that it rests against the back of your lower legs just below the calves and above the Achilles tendons.
Lie face down on the bench with your knees positioned just off the lower edge of the pad, aligning your knee joints with the machine's pivot axis.
Grasp the machine handles firmly and brace your abdominals, pressing your hips flat against the bench.
steps: Curl your legs smoothly upward toward your glutes by flexing your knees.
Pause and squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the contraction, keeping your pelvis anchored to the pad.
Lower the weight slowly under full control back to the starting position without allowing the weight stack to slam.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you curl the weight toward your hips; inhale as you return to the starting position.
cues: Keep your hips glued to the bench.
Drive your heels toward your glutes.
Control the eccentric on the way down.

common_faults.fault: Lifting hips off the bench during the curl.
common_faults.correction: Keep your pelvis pressed firmly into the bench and reduce the weight if necessary to prevent lumbar hyperextension.

common_faults.fault: Misaligning the knees with the pivot point.
common_faults.correction: Adjust the bench or foot pad so the rotational axis of the machine aligns directly with the joint line of your knees.

common_faults.fault: Using momentum and swinging the weight.
common_faults.correction: Perform reps with a controlled tempo and pause briefly at peak contraction.

precautions: Avoid letting the weight pull your knees into hyper-extension at the bottom of the movement.
